tasks.label: Setup: everything
tasks.detail: Start here. Fetches the DSP submodules, installs dependencies (repairing wrong-architecture native binaries), and configures both CMake projects. Idempotent - safe to re-run any time something looks broken

tasks.label: Setup: everything (web only, no C++)
tasks.detail: Same, minus the submodules and CMake - for working on the web app without a C++ toolchain

tasks.label: Install dependencies
tasks.detail: pnpm install across the workspace (apps/web, packages/ui). Prefer "Setup: everything" - it also repairs the wrong-architecture native binaries a pnpm running under emulation installs

tasks.label: Install Playwright browsers
tasks.detail: One-time fetch of the chromium/firefox/webkit binaries used by the e2e suite

tasks.label: Web: Dev server
tasks.detail: Starts the Vite dev server (apps/web) - web app only, no C++ toolchain needed

tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Typecheck + production build of the web app and packages/ui (excludes the native desktop app), via Turborepo

tasks.label: Lint
tasks.detail: oxlint, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Format check
tasks.detail: Prettier --check, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Format write
tasks.detail: Prettier --write

tasks.label: Test (watch)
tasks.detail: Vitest in watch mode (apps/web)

tasks.label: Test (run once)
tasks.detail: Vitest, single run - unit/component tests, via Turborepo

tasks.label: Test coverage
tasks.detail: Vitest with the v8 coverage report (apps/web)

tasks.label: E2E test
tasks.detail: Playwright e2e suite, via Turborepo - needs "Install Playwright browsers" run once first

tasks.label: Storybook
tasks.detail: Starts the Storybook dev server (packages/ui)

tasks.label: Full check (lint + format + build + test + e2e)
tasks.detail: Everything CI runs, in order - see .github/workflows/ci.yml

tasks.label: C++: Init submodules
tasks.detail: One-time fetch of the vendored DSP library submodules (dspark's Effects, NAMCore's Eigen/AudioDSPTools, Dragonfly's dpf) - needed before configuring packages/core. Skips whatever is already present

tasks.label: C++: Configure
tasks.detail: Configures the packages/core C++ DSP library with tests enabled - see packages/core/README.md if cmake isn't on your PATH

tasks.label: C++: Build
tasks.detail: Builds packages/core (graph engine, NAM wrapper, Dragonfly Reverb algorithms)

tasks.label: C++: Test
tasks.detail: Runs the packages/core CTest suite (graph engine, NAM inference, all 4 Dragonfly Reverb algorithms)

tasks.label: Setup & run everything (web + C++)
tasks.detail: One-shot local setup: pnpm install, init/configure/build/test the C++ engine, then start the web dev server

tasks.label: Desktop: Configure (with tests)
tasks.detail: Configures the apps/desktop C++ shell (webview + RtAudio + core) with the CTest suite enabled

tasks.label: Desktop: Build
tasks.detail: Release build of the native desktop app + bundles the React UI into build/ui (scripts/build.mjs)

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (Debug build + launch)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds the desktop app and launches the window against the bundled web UI

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (fast - skip the UI rebuild)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds and launches the desktop app reusing the UI already in build/ui - for C++-only changes

tasks.label: Desktop: Dev (attach to the web dev server)
tasks.detail: Debug-builds and launches the desktop app pointed at http://localhost:5173 (OPENAXE_UI_URL) - needs "Web: Dev server" running, gives the native shell Vite HMR

tasks.label: Dev: web + desktop (parallel)
tasks.detail: Runs the Vite dev server and the native desktop app side by side, each in its own terminal - two independent apps, one command

tasks.label: Build: web + desktop
tasks.detail: Production build of everything: web app, packages/ui, and the native desktop app (needs CMake + a C++20 compiler)

tasks.label: Desktop: C++ tests
tasks.detail: Runs the desktop CTest suite (audio I/O, JS bridge, latency) - needs Configure (with tests) + Build first

tasks.label: Desktop: Package
tasks.detail: Builds the app + UI and runs CPack -> build/openaxe-desktop-<v>.dmg|.zip|.deb

tasks.label: Desktop: Full check (build + C++ tests + web tests)
tasks.detail: Desktop C++ tests + the web suite the UI reuse depends on

tasks.label: VST: Configure (Release)
tasks.detail: Configures the VST3 + standalone plugin (iPlug2 + core, WHOLE_ARCHIVE). Fetches iPlug2 via FetchContent (pinned d54f690) — offline smoke tests still configure. See packages/vst3/README.md

tasks.label: VST: Configure (Debug)
tasks.detail: Debug configure for the VST3 plugin — enables sanitizers and richer diagnostics (use with TSan/RTSan tasks)

tasks.label: VST: Build
tasks.detail: Builds the VST3 bundle + standalone (needs Configure). Smoke/latency/suspend/realtime/editor tests build even without the VST3 SDK or a host

tasks.label: VST: Build (Debug)
tasks.detail: Debug build — pairs with Configure (Debug), for TSan/RTSan instrumented builds

tasks.label: VST: Test
tasks.detail: Runs the VST3 CTest suite (smoke, latency, suspend, param_surface, state, asset, realtime_safety, editor + validators that SKIP when tool/bundle absent) — the single AGENTS.md entry point

tasks.label: VST: Full check (Configure + Build + Test)
tasks.detail: What CI runs locally for the plugin — Configure (Release), Build, Test (13/13 with validators SKIP offline)

tasks.label: VST: Standalone
tasks.detail: Builds and runs the standalone plugin (no DAW needed, same DSP as VST3 — debugger-friendly)

tasks.label: VST: Install bundle (macOS) to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
tasks.command: mkdir -p ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3 && cp -R packages/vst3/build/OpenAxe.vst3 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ 2>/dev/null || cp -R packages/vst3/build/openaxe_vst3.vst3 ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Bundle not yet built — run VST: Build first (looks for OpenAxe.vst3 / openaxe_vst3.vst3)'
tasks.detail: Copies the built .vst3 bundle into the macOS user VST3 dir so a host can scan it (Linux: ~/.vst3/, Windows: %COMMONPROGRAMFILES%\VST3\)

tasks.label: VST: Reveal VST3 bundle
tasks.command: ls -lh packages/vst3/build/*.vst3 2>/dev/null || ls -lh packages/vst3/build/Release/*.vst3 2>/dev/null || ls -lh packages/vst3/build/openaxe*.vst3 2>/dev/null || echo 'No bundle yet — run VST: Build'
tasks.detail: Shows the built VST3 bundle(s) and their sizes

tasks.label: VST: Generate design tokens (CSS)
tasks.detail: Regenerates packages/ui/tokens/{colors,spacing,typography,shadows}.css from design-tokens.json (light/dark palettes — primary target for web/desktop/plugin React, issue #131)

tasks.label: VST: Generate design tokens (C++ header)
tasks.detail: Generates packages/vst3/generated/tokens.h (IColor(a,r,g,b) with rgb(.../...%) resolved, constexpr float spacing) — optional for native controls, issue #131

tasks.label: VST: Generate design tokens (all)
tasks.detail: Regenerates both CSS and the optional C++ header from design-tokens.json — run after editing the JSON

tasks.label: VST: Design tokens drift check
tasks.detail: Fails if the generated CSS/C++ drift from design-tokens.json — what CI runs (.github/workflows/ci.yml)

tasks.label: VST: TSan build & test
tasks.command: cmake -S packages/vst3 -B packages/vst3/build-tsan -DOPENAXE_VST3_ENABLE_TSAN=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && cmake --build packages/vst3/build-tsan -j && ctest --test-dir packages/vst3/build-tsan --output-on-failure
tasks.detail: ThreadSanitizer over the concurrent suspend/editor stress (issue #130) — Linux GCC/Clang only (Apple Clang ships no libclang_rt.tsan for arm64)

tasks.label: VST: RTSan build & test (Clang 18+)
tasks.command: cmake -S packages/vst3 -B packages/vst3/build-rtsan -DOPENAXE_VST3_ENABLE_RTSAN=ON && cmake --build packages/vst3/build-rtsan -j && ctest --test-dir packages/vst3/build-rtsan --output-on-failure -R realtime
tasks.detail: RealtimeSanitizer over the realtime_safety test (issue #130) — traps allocations/locks/syscalls on the audio thread, Clang 18+ only

tasks.label: VST: Validators (pluginval/auval/VST3 validator/clap-validator)
tasks.detail: Runs the host validator CTests — SKIP with a message when the external tool or built bundle is absent, validate strictly when present (pluginval --strictness 10, auval -v aufx Nms1 NwSt)

tasks.label: WASM: Build core (Emscripten)
tasks.detail: Compiles packages/core to WASM via Emscripten — overwrites apps/web/public/wasm-core/{js,wasm}. Needs emsdk on PATH. Run after changing include/openaxe/api.h or EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS

tasks.label: Drift: gen-param-schema --check
tasks.detail: Checks web paramSchema.ts ↔ packages/core param_schema.json agreement (issue #51). Run without --check to fix. For plugin automation map use next task

tasks.label: Drift: gen-param-schema (automation-map) --check
tasks.detail: Checks plugin automation slot layout packages/vst3/generated/automation_param_map.h (issue #121, --target=automation-map)

tasks.label: Drift: check-grid-dims --check
tasks.detail: Checks grid row/col constants TS (gridConfig.ts) vs C++ (grid_config.h) — issue #61. Use --fix to repair

tasks.label: Drift: check-wasm-exports --check
tasks.detail: Checks every _nam_studio_* symbol the web app calls is in packages/core CMake EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS — issue #70. Use --fix to rewrite CMakeLists.txt

tasks.label: Drift: sync-version --check
tasks.detail: Checks every package.json version matches root VERSION file — issue #54. Run without --check to sync

tasks.label: Build Storybook
tasks.detail: Static Storybook build, scans packages/ui stories — mirrors ci.yml Build Storybook step

tasks.label: Remotion: Studio
tasks.detail: Starts Remotion Studio (apps/remotion) — preview 5 compositions (Hero/Amp/Effects/CabMixer/Platforms) at 720p, Carbon/Aluminum, issue #298. Needs pnpm install first. Then open http://localhost:3000

tasks.label: Remotion: Render all
tasks.command: for id in Hero HeroAluminum Amp AmpAluminum Effects EffectsAluminum CabMixer CabMixerAluminum Platforms PlatformsAluminum; do echo "→ Rendering $id"; pnpm --filter @openaxe/remotion exec remotion render src/index.ts "$id" "../landing/public/videos/$id.mp4" --codec=h264 --image-format=jpeg || exit 1; pnpm --filter @openaxe/remotion exec remotion still src/index.ts "$id" "../landing/public/videos/$id-poster.jpg" --frame=0 || exit 1; done; echo "Done — see apps/landing/public/videos/ (6.7 MB)"
tasks.detail: Renders all 10 compositions (5 × Carbon/Aluminum, 720p 10s h264 silent) + posters to apps/landing/public/videos/ — committed artifacts like wasm-core, issue #298

tasks.label: Remotion: Still check
tasks.command: pnpm --filter @openaxe/remotion exec remotion still src/index.ts Hero ../landing/public/videos/Hero-poster-check.jpg --frame=30 --scale=0.5
tasks.detail: One-frame still sanity check at 1s mark (720p, frame 30) — verifies layout/colors before full render, see remotion-markup skill

tasks.label: Remotion: Typecheck
tasks.detail: Typechecks apps/remotion compositions (theme, shared, Root) — must be clean before render

tasks.label: Remotion: Bundle
tasks.detail: Bundles apps/remotion for Studio/render — verifies all 10 compositions bundle without Chrome
